# hiok_scheduled_task (Resource)

Starts, stops, restarts or snapshots a resource on a schedule — e.g. a nightly VM snapshot keeping the newest 7.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Snapshot the VM every night at 02:30 IST, keeping the newest 7.
resource "hiok_scheduled_task" "nightly_backup" {
  resource_type = "virtualmachine"
  resource_id   = hiok_virtual_machine.web.id
  name          = "nightly-backup"
  action        = "snapshot"
  schedule_time = "02:30"
  time_zone     = "Asia/Kolkata"
  keep_count    = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) start, stop, restart or snapshot (VMs).
- `name` (String)
- `resource_id` (String) The resource's id.
- `resource_type` (String) virtualmachine or container.
- `schedule_time` (String) HH:MM, e.g. 02:30.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `keep_count` (Number) For snapshot: how many automatic snapshots to keep (1-30).
- `schedule_days` (String) e.g. Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri; empty = every day.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_result` (String)
- `next_run` (String)
